description:
## Goal

An unchanged request reuses everything and performs essentially no compiler work. An unrelated edit invalidates nothing for the requested root. A relevant edit recomputes only the exact transitive dependents of what changed.

## Priorities

1. Correct semantics by construction: one denotation, one identity, exact ownership, typed comparisons, and no display strings or incidental order as authority.
2. Collapse duplicate concepts and authorities: one World fact authority and one retained ProductMemo authority.
3. Work is edge-triggered by precise source, fact, product, demand, or dependency movement.
4. Equal reproduction preserves allocation and generation, wakes nobody, and deep-copies nothing.
5. Recursive publications converge and retract through the ordinary scheduler.
6. Native compilation is body-incremental.
7. Source replacement owns and withdraws exact contributions.
8. Deterministic causal counts prove less work; wall time and CI duration corroborate.
9. No probes, adapters, duplicate tests, migration scaffolding, or obsolete documentation remain after cutover.

## Architectural decisions

- InputDemand is derived directly from source-owned LoweredBody, EntryDispatch, and exact peer facts. InputFlow, a second semantic body, reconstructed frames, and private demand cones/solvers do not exist in the final model.
- Source acceptance and completed attempts publish owner-qualified, content-specific semantic support before joins erase it. Observed reads remain invalidation dependencies; the scheduler routes precise changes but does not infer support from key reachability, finality, source-body reads, or ProductMemo membership. The existing World domain stores remain the sole value authorities.
- submit_source creates a new typed owner. replace_source(owner, text) is the only edit operation. Identical replacement is a no-op. A rejected replacement leaves the accepted version current; failure after acceptance withdraws stale derived claims while retaining exact observations and diagnostics.
- ActivationInputs is the sole correlated input-evidence authority. No activation key is decoded to manufacture evidence.
- Native bodies are exact retained products keyed by semantic codegen inputs. The post-lowering whole-root sharing pass disappears.
- Immutable source versions may remain for exact provenance owners. No duplicate World, rollback image, duplicate semantic state, generic support-value store, or reconciliation pass is permitted.

## Accepted DAG

fz-tfn.59 is the sole stack/inclusion frontier. It rebuilds the branch above accepted PR #121 and #122, excludes invalid PR #123, deletes dormant per-derivation scheduler identity as the first real commit, and creates/submits the new draft recalculator PR in the gh stack.

After that boundary:

- fz-tfn.57 atomically establishes source ownership, accepted replacement, failed-attempt completion, and content-specific recursive publication support. It absorbs the valid law from fz-kdt.213; there is no scheduler-metadata-only support layer.
- fz-kdt.46 makes fact demand and subscription replacement exact-edge-triggered.
- fz-tfn.6 deletes the activation frontier in favor of exact appearance edges.
- fz-tfn.15 removes scan-era scheduling/telemetry/accounting residue.
- fz-tfn.47 gives product requests one exact lifecycle and trigger.
- fz-kdt.188 removes fabricated Cartesian activation evidence.
- fz-kdt.200 derives final InputDemand and activation identity directly from authoritative bodies.
- fz-kdt.48 establishes denotational Ty and exact paired-evidence identity.
- fz-tfn.14 makes ActivationInputs one change-aware store.
- fz-tfn.40 separates executable content from diagnostic provenance.
- fz-tfn.13 makes native lowering/codegen/linking body-incremental.
- fz-tfn.20 reclaims source versions with no remaining exact owner.
- fz-tfn.52 and fz-tfn.56 remove residual final-model scheduler/product work.
- fz-kdt.114 audits only residual blocked-wait display ordering and scan residue after the exact-edge cutover.
- fz-tfn.60 is the final exact-reuse and debris-removal proof.

The authoritative dependency shape is:

```text
.59 -> .57 -> .46 -> .6 -> .200 -> .48 -> .14
        |      |      |                 -> .13 (also after .40)
        |      |      -> .15
        |      -> .52
        |      -> .114
        |      -> .56 (also after .47)
        -> .40 -> .20
        -> .47

.188 -> .200

.13, .14, .15, .20, .52, .56, .114 -> .60
```

bw dependencies are authoritative for execution order and reject cycles. This prose must be updated whenever the DAG changes; every edge must be necessary and sufficient.

## Ticket consolidation

The following acceptance contracts are absorbed, not discarded:

- fz-tfn.59 absorbs fz-tfn.21 because stack creation needs the first real deletion commit to form one reviewable atomic boundary.
- fz-tfn.57 absorbs fz-tfn.53, fz-kdt.24, fz-kdt.30, fz-kdt.32, fz-tfn.45, fz-tfn.46, and the valid recursive-retraction law from fz-kdt.213. The former scheduler-metadata-only implementation premise of fz-kdt.213 is refuted.
- fz-kdt.200 absorbs the valid laws from invalid fz-kdt.214, superseded fz-kdt.220 and fz-kdt.75, the InputDemand-specific obligations formerly associated with fz-kdt.213, and fz-kdt.165.
- fz-kdt.48 absorbs fz-0za and fz-kdt.173.
- fz-tfn.14 absorbs fz-tfn.19.
- fz-kdt.46 absorbs fz-kdt.7.
- fz-tfn.15 absorbs fz-tfn.16.
- fz-tfn.47 absorbs fz-tfn.32.
- fz-tfn.13 absorbs fz-tfn.42 and fz-tfn.43.
- fz-kdt.68 is refuted by its measured regression and lack of a production consumer; fz-tfn.59 removes the dormant substrate.
- fz-kdt.114 remains a narrow post-cutover absence audit. fz-kdt.49 is obsolete as written; global type-mint and row confluence belongs to fz-kdt.48.
- fz-tfn.39, fz-tfn.54 and fz-tfn.58 remain tracked outside this epic.
- fz-tt2 owns PR #124's independent dangling-ticket and title correction; it does not block this epic.

## Execution protocol

One implementation ticket equals one code commit and one close. Before creating any new issue, inspect existing tickets and open PRs for overlap, contradiction, and ordering. Correct descriptions directly; do not append contradictory comments.

Hard architectural tickets use a pre-implementation high-capacity validation and a separate fresh cold ticket-scoped adversarial review of the frozen candidate. Reviews assess only the ticket and epic invariants.

fz-tfn.59 creates and submits the new draft PR above #122 with gh stacks and its implementation commit counts as accepted ticket 1. Each stack layer contains at most ten accepted ticket commits; the next completed ticket after each tenth commit creates/submits a new draft layer. Work may begin while CI runs, but no later ticket is pushed until the preceding pushed head is green.

## Completion

Same input means reuse; unrelated change means no requested-root work; relevant change means only necessary work, while every semantic answer and required artifact contract remains correct.
title: Compiler2: eliminate batch work and become a long-lived recalculator
